acceptedFindings.basis: Independently matches accepted Claude-002 F1. The character-level Daijisen entry defines 析 as こまかく分かつ / こみ入ったものを解きほぐす (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:4-7) and KANJIDIC2 lists divide (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:52); the frozen card itself teaches separating things into parts (snapshot/kanji/析.md:23). 別 displays 'separate, another' (repo/kanji/別.md:3) and 離 displays 'separate; detach' (repo/kanji/離.md:3). 析.md:14 declares [分, 解, 割, 切, 破, 剖, 板]; 別.md has no quiz_exclusions; 離.md:14 declares [別, 分, 放, 去] but not 析. The content contract makes exclusions symmetric but non-transitive and requires checking displayed labels against ordinary meanings (repo/docs/content-format.md:100-114).
acceptedFindings.fix: Append 別 and 離 to 析's quiz_exclusions while preserving all seven original exclusions, and explain the direct separation overlap concisely in Notes. Do not remove the source-supported dividing sense to suppress the collision or claim the characters' words are interchangeable.
acceptedFindings.scope: A bounded semantic safeguard. Neither is among 析's current curated distractors; this does not claim a demonstrated default-pool collision or native/arbitrary-pool acceptance.

acceptanceLimit: Bounded independent evidence, not publication approval. Accepted findings require signed fixes and confirmation; the raw report is unchanged.
